reason: The dragon needs a secure mounting point, so I’ll fit its bracket to the whale.

effect: The whale now has a dragon mount, so I can attach the dragon.
reaction: A straightforward preparation; nothing surprising yet.
reason: The mount is ready, and securing the dragon is part of the goal.
expectation: I expect the dragon to attach to the mount, though it may need further securing.

effect: Both attractions are aboard, but they still need securing.

effect: The pins are prepared and can now be fitted to the whale.
reason: This is the only offered combination and should secure the attractions.

effect: The mounts are locked; the accessory supply is the next available fitting.
reaction: The pins' purpose is clear, though the mounting sequence has been repetitive.
reason: The fused supply is the only offered combination and appears to provide power for an attraction.
expectation: I expect it to connect accessory power to the whale, though I’m unsure which attraction it serves.

effect: The whale now has accessory power; the cable ties are the remaining offered fitting.
reaction: The power connection was straightforward, but its specific use is still unclear.
reason: The only offered combination should tidy and secure the accessory cables.
expectation: I expect the loops to hold the cables in place, possibly completing the installation.

effect: The cable loops keep wires clear of the two hand-operated mechanisms, and the attractions are secured; the chapter is complete.
reaction: I appreciated the clear reminder that neither attraction gained an invisible motor.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the cable loops was the most worthwhile moment: it explained how the attractions remain operable together and clarified their power.

leastWorthwhile.text: The successive bracket and attraction fittings felt repetitive, with little detail in their results.

surprise.text: The final result clarified that both attractions remain hand-operated despite the accessory power; I had been unsure what that supply served.

arbitrary.text: The accessory supply’s particular purpose remained unclear, although keeping its wires away from moving parts made sense.

continue.text: I would be curious to see the loaded whale fly, but the repetitive mounting steps alone would not be a strong reason to continue.
